Electrobatons.label: Electrobatons
Electrobatons.description:
Pierce 2. Surge: +1 Damage.
Flurry of Blows: After attack, free melee attack (1 green die, +1 Damage). 1/activation.
Deadly: -1 Evade to defense results.

Electrohammer.label: Electrohammer
Electrohammer.description:
Pierce 2. Surge: +2 Damage.
Electro-pulse: After attack, each figure adjacent to target suffers 1 Strain.

Electrostaff.label: Electrostaff
Electrostaff.description:
Pierce 2. Reach. Surge: +1 Damage.
Quick Strike: After attack, if defender rerolled/modified defense, defender suffers 1 Strain.

Scout.label: Scout
Scout.description:
+2 Accuracy, +1 Evade surge, +2 Block surge.
Surge: +2 Accuracy, Pierce 1.
Rifleman: Replace 1 attack die with 1 blue die.
Priority Target: Figures don't block LOS for your attacks.

Senator.label: Senator
Senator.description:
+1 Accuracy, +1 Surge surge, +1 Block surge.
Surge: Recover 2. Surge: Gain 1 Power Token.
Conspire: Distribute 1 Power Token per attack die to friendlies within 1 space.

Soldier.label: Soldier
Soldier.description:
+1 Accuracy, +1 Damage surge, +1 Block surge.
Surge: +2 Accuracy. Surge: Blast 1 Strain.
Shields Up: Place energy shield adjacent (Health 4, no defense).
Professional: Reroll 1 attack die.

Streetrat.label: Streetrat
Streetrat.description:
+1 Surge, +Gain 1 Power Token surge.
Surge: +1 Damage.
Assassin's Blade: After attack, roll 1 red die, adjacent hostile suffers Strain = Hits.
Fleet: +2 MP at activation start.
